Women's Hospital "Room Harmony" has been etched in my memory as it  was my home for two and a half months.

Another appreciation I would want to give the phlebotomist who would come for my blood tests and would tell me lovingly that I would be a good mom. I forgot her name but I hope you guys will find out who she is.

It was a tumultuous journey for both me and my husband, but the way Dr. Gayatri Rao made my pregnancy possible with her positive smile and golden words is beyond everything.

It was a long stay but it became bearable with each and every person mentioned above. Thank you guys, for helping me out during the most fragile yet memorable time of my life. I will always be indebted to this hospital.

I have always believed that large hospitals are the most reliable places for pregnancy scans. So when my gynaecologist recommended Harmony Clinic, I visited with some hesitation, assuming it would be a one-time appointment. What followed, however, was an experience that genuinely redefined my expectations of diagnostic care.
Harmony Clinic offers not just clinical excellence, but a rare combination of precision, empathy, and thoughtful design—something I had not encountered even in leading hospitals across Mumbai. Every visit felt reassuring, respectful, and deeply human.

What truly sets Harmony Clinic apart:

1) Radiologist:
Dr. Mitossh is exceptional-Despite a consistently busy schedule, he never rushes a scan. His approach is meticulous, patient, and detail-oriented. Most importantly, he takes the time to explain every aspect of the scan with clarity and calmness—offering reassurance that is invaluable for an expecting mother.

2) Infrastructure:
The clinic’s infrastructure is intelligently designed with patient experience at its core. Separate screens for the doctor, the patient, and the companion ensure transparency and involvement at every step. The availability of advanced 4D scans further elevates the experience.

3) Turnaround Time (TAT):
The efficiency is remarkable. Reports and 4D images are shared within minutes, not hours or days! Digital reports are promptly delivered via WhatsApp/email, making the process seamless and stress-free.

3) Ambiance and staff
Pregnancy scans—especially critical ones like NT/NB—can be emotionally intense. Harmony Clinic thoughtfully curates a calming environment with soothing music. A particularly moving moment was when they played my favourite prayers during the scan. It transformed anxiety into calm and allowed me to truly experience the joy of the moment and the staff at the clinic are very friendly.

Harmony Clinic is not merely a diagnostic centre; it is a space where clinical excellence meets compassion and design. I am deeply grateful for the care, sensitivity, and professionalism I experienced here. Infact for my last scan due to some constraints I could not travel to the clinic, hence Dr. Mitossh even refered another radilogist at a hospital closer to me which was very helpfull. Without hesitation, I would recommend Harmony Clinic to every expecting parent.

featured_reviews.name: vinayak das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review for Harmony Clinic – Dr. Mitosh
We visited Harmony Clinic for a heart and facial scan. Our appointment was at 2:00 PM. We reached at 1:30 PM and were finally called inside at 3:00 PM. We were patient and clearly told the doctor that we were okay to wait and that he could take his time.
While waiting, the doctor was loudly complaining about other patients, their behavior, and mobile phone usage. We ignored this and remained cooperative.
However, once the scan started, the experience became extremely uncomfortable. As patients—especially first-time parents—curiosity and questions are natural. When my wife asked a few questions out of excitement and concern, the doctor replied very rudely, saying, “Don’t ask anything, just see the screen and feel.”
He repeatedly shouted at his staff in front of us, saying things like “You people don’t use your brain,” which was very unprofessional. He also told my wife “Your stomach is too stiff, loosen it,” without explaining what he meant. This made her nervous and uncomfortable.
Throughout the scan, he kept addressing her as “Madam, Madam” in a taunting and disrespectful tone. Eventually, he asked us to wait and come back later. We returned again at 4:30 PM.
During the second scan, when my wife asked about the baby’s weight, he bluntly said, “I will not tell you. It’s not important. Just feel it.” He even made sarcastic remarks like “Main aapka student hoon, aap teacher ho Madam,” which was completely unnecessary and insulting. (My wife is a teacher by profession.)
No matter how skilled a doctor may be, behavior, empathy, and basic respect towards patients matter. This experience was stressful, humiliating, and emotionally disturbing.
We will not be visiting this clinic again and would not recommend it to anyone who expects professional and respectful patient care.
